extDescription.message: Insert predefined text snippets while writing emails: type /tag and pick from the list.

errKeySpaces.message: Spaces are not allowed. Use "-" to join words (e.g. info-spanish).

errKeyUnderscore.message: "_" is not allowed. Use "-" to join words (e.g. info-spanish).

errKeyInvalid.message: Use only letters and numbers, with single "-" between words (e.g. info-spanish).

errNameDuplicate.message: A snippet with this name already exists.

errBodyRequired.message: The snippet text cannot be empty.

errBodyTooLarge.message: The snippet text is too long.

errSnippetNotFound.message: This snippet no longer exists. It may have been deleted.

errTriggerInvalid.message: The trigger must be 1 to 3 symbols, with no letters, numbers or spaces.

errImportNotJson.message: The file is not valid JSON.

errImportFormat.message: This file is not a Help Desk Helper snippet export.

errImportVersion.message: This file was made by a newer version of Help Desk Helper. Update the add-on first.

errImportDuplicateInFile.message: This name appears more than once in the file. Only the first one was imported.

listEmpty.message: No snippets yet. Click “New snippet” to create one, or import a file.

welcomeHowTo.message: While writing an email, type $TRIGGER$ followed by at least $MIN$ letters of a tag or name (for example $EXAMPLE$). Choose a snippet with ↑ and ↓, then press Enter, Tab or Space to insert it. Esc closes the list.

welcomeSelect.message: Select a snippet on the left to edit it, or create a new one.

fieldNameHint.message: One word; use - to join words (e.g. info-spanish).

fieldTagsHint.message: Press Space, Enter or comma after each tag. Same rules as the name.

deleteConfirm.message: “$NAME$” will be deleted. This can't be undone.

unsavedConfirm.message: This snippet has changes that are not saved. Discard them?

errLinkInvalid.message: Use an address that starts with https://, http://, mailto: or tel:.

optTriggerHint.message: Typed at the start of a word to open the snippet list. 1 to 3 symbols; the default is /.

importConfirm.message: “$FILE$” contains $COUNT$ snippets. How do you want to import them?

importMergeHelp.message: Merge: adds the new snippets. A local snippet with the same name is replaced by the imported one.

importReplaceHelp.message: Replace all: deletes all current snippets first. A backup file is exported automatically before that.

popupHint.message: ↑↓ choose · Enter, Tab or Space insert · Esc close
